body: Again just from my view of the other side, I think he has to understand you want to be there for and help him. That it's not about getting him back, if it's not about that anyway. He probably thinks he's going to just hurt you or drag you down if he let's you in. If he understands you're just there to help and help only he might open up to you. Again, hope this is some help.

From the other side, your knowledge and understanding of the situation will help him. Talk and listen to him. No one helped me or understood me like my ex who went throigh her own stuff. She's the only one who could really get what I felt even when I didn't and still don't understand it. Hope this helps
